title: Start with the recording
lines: Before you retrain, check the alignment.
Do the camera and lidar agree about where that object is?
Deepen AI can calibrate from an eligible recording you already have.
Compare the before-and-after report. Start with the evidence.
evidence: A real approved sensor overlay and calibration report. Do not manufacture a successful calibration or imply every recording qualifies.
beats: 0–2s: visible misalignment / hook. 2–8s: compare one object in the same frame. 8–15s: the existing recording and scoped workflow. 15–21s: approved report and one next step.

title: Before you collect more
lines: Before you collect more robot data, check what already exists.
The useful question is whether it fits your task, sensors, and rights.
On Deepen Refinery, inspect samples and formats before choosing a dataset.
Start with fit, then decide what to collect.
evidence: An actual cleared Refinery listing and its samples. No invented collection cost, catalog total or guaranteed model gain.
cta: Explore dataset fit through Deepen Refinery.
beats: 0–2s: task/demo footage / hook. 2–8s: the missing task or condition. 8–15s: real sample, format and usage-rights views. 15–22s: next step for buyers.

title: A second use for a recording
lines: That recording may have value beyond the original project.
First, check what your team owns and what it can license.
Deepen Refinery lets suppliers define licensing terms and retain ownership.
Explore the supplier route. Useful data deserves a second look.
evidence: Client-approved supplier workflow and rights language. Confirm eligibility for the depicted owner. No fabricated sale, payout or earnings claim.
cta: Explore supplying data through Deepen Refinery.
beats: 0–2s: an existing session on a drive / hook. 2–8s: ownership and permitted reuse. 8–15s: cleared listing/rights workflow. 15–22s: supplier next step.
